ordered_migration_phases.name: rebind-and-freeze-inputs
ordered_migration_phases.effect: rehash all 15 source inputs and stop on drift

ordered_migration_phases.name: install-v2-schemas
ordered_migration_phases.effect: stage the two schemas without changing instance admission

ordered_migration_phases.name: copy-v1-definition-catalogues
ordered_migration_phases.effect: preserve the exact v1 definition-source catalogue plus all concept, property, relation, operator, and language-projection definitions byte-semantically

ordered_migration_phases.name: materialize-six-not-admitted-instances
ordered_migration_phases.effect: create evidence-bound implementation instances with separated axes and no promotion records

ordered_migration_phases.name: materialize-only-exact-supporting-and-relation-rows
ordered_migration_phases.effect: create evidence-bound supporting endpoints only when exact stable IDs exist, create three Enum composition rows, and leave unresolved row-level endpoints as typed residue; supporting endpoints remain not-admitted and authority-none

ordered_migration_phases.name: derive-v2-projection
ordered_migration_phases.effect: recompute separate non-authoritative implementation, supporting, and relation projection rows from source instances and PromotionRecords

ordered_migration_phases.name: dual-validate-and-compare
ordered_migration_phases.effect: run v1 continuity, v2 schema, hostile, projection, and no-promotion checks

ordered_migration_phases.name: fresh-owner-acceptance
ordered_migration_phases.effect: request exact-byte approval for a separately staged apply package

promotion_phase.required_future_work: one separately accepted PromotionRecord per implementation or relation instance; supporting instances are ineligible in v2; no batch inference from WP-RMT-001 proof receipts

rollback.strategy: while promotion_records is empty, restore the three exact raw-byte v1 preimages and remove only the two added schema paths
rollback.active_promotion_record_policy: rollback is blocked while any accepted PromotionRecord exists; v2 deliberately defines no suspension, retirement, or reversal transition, so a separately accepted reversal/export schema must be proposed, validated, and applied before v1 restoration can be reconsidered
rollback.precondition: promotion_records.length == 0 and no derived implementation, supporting, or relation projection row is admitted

claim_ceiling: This map proposes a future schema migration. It does not alter the v1 ontology or projection, migrate or admit any candidate, create a PromotionRecord, grant authority, publish, release, deploy, or establish production readiness.
